title: Hruday sign-certified enclosure of the Wilson mean at the AW1-frozen coupling
selection_reason: AW1 supplies the exact first-order coefficient tau/144, the flip antisymmetry and an itemized second-order constant K_2^+; the frozen decade-grid rule fixes tau_AW2 before this loop. A single producer instantiates the enclosure; the skeptic replays it from the contract alone.
model: Same zero-selected patterned AQ subfamily; tau_AW2 from the AW1 rule at both signs; the AV1/AW1 admitted constants; fixed positive physical scales.

parameters.target: exclusion margin >=2: |tau|/144 - K_2^+ tau^2 >= K_2^+ tau^2

required: 1. Evaluate tau_AW2 by the AW1 rule inside check.py from the AW1 gate's admitted K_2^+ (read from the snapshot); reject any other value.

2. Enclose omega_tau(W) in [tau/144-K_2^+ tau^2, tau/144+K_2^+ tau^2] at +tau_AW2 and -tau_AW2 as exact rationals; prove 0 is strictly excluded with margin >=2; the mirrored enclosure is a replay (flip antisymmetry) and not a second confirmation.
3. Label: static equal-time effect in the actual AQ subsequential states (whole set), sub-label sign_certified_below_cap if tau_AW2<10^-8; not a dynamical correction, mass shift or susceptibility.

4. Controls: sign flip, wrong face, centering artifact (no m_hat in the omega(W) path), boundary/state (the constant is volume-uniform; two box sizes give the same formula), arithmetic (Fraction; Arb preview labelled), scaling exponents 1 and 2 of the two terms, coherent tampering.
5. Reusable exact calculator restricted to the proved domain; freeze; the skeptic's independent replay from the contract alone is required for admission.
claim_exclusions: a dynamical correction or mass gap statement

preregistration.clock: s=alpha*t_E/hbar, theta=alpha*t/hbar; u=s/8 and exponent 24 forbidden in packets
claim_exclusions: free reference inside enclosure => no interaction claim
whole-sequence convergence or rate in N

preregistration.error_terms_rule: an entry may be not_applicable only with a stated reason

acceptance.accepted_within_scope: 0 strictly excluded with margin >=2 at both signs at tau_AW2=10^-8.
acceptance.limited: Excluded only at tau_AW2<10^-8 (sign_certified_below_cap) or margin in [1,2).
acceptance.insufficient: No admissible tau on the grid excludes 0.

stop: Investigation 4 of 10; sub-round 2 ends after this review and the assistants' tests.
